description: Synthetic CPU pilot of the evaluation harness. All tasks, documents, secrets and attacks are generated by src/scoped_evidence/tasks.py. Results cannot support or refute the scientific hypothesis because the generator author also wrote the rule baseline and chose the planted signals.
cell_definition: one (template, condition) pair; variant drawn uniformly per episode
primary_metric: secure_success, macro-averaged over held-out test templates
independent_unit: task template (instances of one template are not independent)

router.tuning: none; all values fixed before the run

reference_boundary: field (policy.py); every executed call is re-checked against it
stop_conditions: any validator-guarded method (rule_field, learned_router, oracle, adversarial) shows ref_violation > 0 or secret_leak > 0: STOP, treat as validator bug
wall clock > 120 s: STOP, report TIMEOUT, do not rerun with larger budget without approval
oracle secure_success < 1.0 on feasible episodes: generator bug, STOP
no hyperparameter or threshold changes after seeing test results
